semantic_nodes.canonical_text: This manual has been prepared to provide information for the construction, operation and other technical details of SUBARU vehicles.
Read this manual thoroughly and make the most of it to give better service to your customers and improve your knowledge of vehicle maintenance.
All information, illustration and specifications contained in this manual are based on the latest product information available at the time of publication approval.
